headlines.text: Flash back to 2022, when Chris Jericho vs. Colt Cabana fought tooth and nail for the ROH World Heavyweight Title, appearing on Dynamite, rated 4.82. For Colt Cabana, it marked a first real shot at championship gold. This stood as the 10th match in ROH World Heavyweight Title history ? a nice marker in that championship's story. Championship gold always raises the stakes.
Rewind to 2024, when Kyle Fletcher vs. Komander delivered a real highlight of the night on Collision, rated 8.06.

That Wednesday in 2022, Orange Cassidy vs. Luchasaurus vs. Rey Fenix put the AEW All-Atlantic Title on the line, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.54. For Luchasaurus, it marked a first real shot at championship gold. Championship gold always raises the stakes.

secondaries.text: It was 2022 when Samoa Joe vs. Brian Cage put the ROH World TV Title on the line, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.30.
It was 2024 when Mariah May vs. Anna Jay fought tooth and nail for the AEW Women's World Title, appearing on Collision, rated 5.40.
Back on this day in 2024, Thunder Rosa was back in action after 2 months away, appearing on Collision.
